lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: Counselor.

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: Coooounssssserlllorrrr.

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: Anybody there?

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: Heeeeellooooo?

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: ooooooooo

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: ooooo

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: Finally!

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: Are you doing anything?

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: Can you fetch some goods for me?

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: I had everything planned out for yesterday,

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: but then one of my tunnels got blocked.

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: I need to get a move on, or else the deal will be called off,

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: and it'd take a good long while before I can dig another tunnel.

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: I've got some primo items lined up today, super important.
Are you sure me picking them up is okay?
Do you want me to help clear the tunnel?

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: Sure, it's no problem at all.

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: I don't think that'll be necessary.

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: Just picking up the merchandise will be more than enough.

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: I'll head to your room once I've got the tunnel cleared.
Okay, just tell me when and where the drop-off is going to be.
... No reply.

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: All done!

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: That was easy.

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: I won't be needing you to go.

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: Problem solved!
Did you sort everything out?

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: Yep!

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: There was a thick plank in the way.

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: I thought dealing with it would be a major headache,

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: but I smashed it with one well-timed blow.

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: I shouldn't have worried!

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: Kinda feel a bit silly now :p

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: I just wonder who put the plank there in the first place...

lines.speaker: quency
lines.text: Anyway, gotta run. See ya!
